mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipes (user_id, name, description, cover_image_url, servings, cook_time_minutes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{servings}, #{cookTimeMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, description, cover_image_url, servings, cook_time_minutes, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM recipes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, description, cover_image_url, servings, cook_time_minutes, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM recipes WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
